title: Compile-time computation
hints: Recursive template: `Fib<N>::value = Fib<N-1>::value + Fib<N-2>::value`, with specialisations `Fib<0>` and `Fib<1>`.
The `constexpr` function can use a plain loop (C++14 onwards).
`Power<B, E>`: `B * Power<B, E-1>::value`, with `Power<B, 0>` as a partial specialisation.
